featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Comfort Spa at Hub Mall Goregaon East, expecting a relaxing and rejuvenating experience. Unfortunately, my visit was marred by several issues that left me feeling disappointed, overcharged, and disrespected.

_1. Exorbitant Prices_

The fees quoted by Comfort Spa are extremely high compared to other professional massage centers in the area. I was expecting a premium experience, but the services didn't match the price.

_2. Miscommunication_

When I booked my appointment, the receptionist quoted ₹2000. However, upon arrival, I was told that the price would be ₹3000. This discrepancy was not only surprising but also felt like a bait-and-switch tactic.

_3. Unhygienic Room_

The room I was initially given was not ready, and I had to change rooms after completing the massage. This lack of attention to detail and preparation was unprofessional.

_4. Unrelaxing Ambiance_

Instead of soothing music, loud Bollywood songs played in the room, making it difficult for me to relax. A spa experience should be calming, not overwhelming.

_5. Unprofessional Therapist_

Janvhi, the massage therapist, seemed inexperienced and unaware of pressure points. Her technique consisted of simply applying oil and rubbing my body, which was not what I expected from a professional massage.

_6. Upselling_

Throughout the massage, Janvhi repeatedly asked if I wanted to avail of extra services, starting at ₹3000. This felt like an aggressive sales tactic rather than a genuine attempt to enhance my experience.

_7. Unprofessional Behavior_

featured_reviews.name: Meeta Gamre
featured_reviews.review_text: Zanya Wellness Spa Salons, I must say, my experience has been exceptional. I'd been following Shilpa on Instagram and watching Zanya's reels before deciding to visit. Given my hectic job and neglecting my well-being, I felt it was time to prioritize myself. Since starting sessions at Zanya, I've noticed a significant improvement in my skin, including reduced pigmentation, and back pain has also decreased. I've had repeated sessions and the results are promising. The staff is very knowledgeable, caring, and always greets me warmly. Shilpa is particularly excellent; her warm welcome and expertise make every visit special. My time at Zanya is 'me time,' allowing me to recharge. I highly recommend their services—definitely worth a visit!"
